problem_restatement: Incorporate the first technically resolved prospective BRENTOIL oil-shock lifecycle into the existing V57 promotion decision without retuning after observing its result.
uncertainties_and_failure_modes: One prospective short cannot estimate repeatable expectancy or rule out a profitable BRENTOIL mechanism.
Modeled net excludes funding and is not realized venue PnL.
Mark-triggered exits use the next complete recorded REST depth rather than a submitted order fill.
Archive public-trade OHLC and live candleSnapshot OHLC remain mismatched on part of their overlap.
Validation and holdout remain unopened and historical mark paths remain incomplete.
Continuing the same post-result parameter search would increase selection bias.

recommendation.1_recommendation: Keep the current BRENTOIL oil-shock candidate deferred and do not add it to V57.
recommendation.2_why_now: The first technically resolved prospective lifecycle is now available and stopped out under both nominal and stress friction.
recommendation.3_evidence_reviewed: The prior immutable V57 BRENTOIL pipeline decision and the immutable first prospective lifecycle snapshot.
recommendation.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: The candidate remains liquid and executable in visible depth, but development stress is negative and its first resolved prospective short lost after modeled costs.
recommendation.5_applicable_market_regime: Five-minute BRENTOIL oil-shock mean reversion under the frozen 30-bps stop, 40-bps target, and 60-minute maximum hold.
recommendation.6_alternatives: Promote now, retune after seeing the loss, keep collecting the frozen mechanism, or preregister a materially different mechanism. Promotion and post-result tuning remain unsupported.
recommendation.8_expected_upside: Avoid allocating live capital to a stress-negative candidate whose first resolved prospective lifecycle also lost.
recommendation.9_main_risks: Deferral may miss a later profitable regime; one short is sparse; excluded funding can change the exact modeled loss; a different BRENTOIL mechanism may work.
recommendation.10_validation_completed: Exact immutable lifecycle identity, causal signal and entry timestamps, visible-depth entry and exit, nominal and stress friction, stop attribution, and technical-path resolution.
recommendation.11_validation_still_required: Exact live/archive candle parity, complete mark paths, funding, both-side prospective evidence, unopened validation and holdout, and positive stress excluding the largest winner.
recommendation.12_success_metrics: Positive after-cost stress, profit factor above one, positive net excluding the largest winner, complete technical paths, source parity, and resolved long and short forward evidence.
recommendation.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: No rollback applies because no live change is proposed. Reopen only under the existing preregistered condition or for a materially different mechanism specified before observing results.
recommendation.14_confidence: High confidence that this frozen candidate is not approval-ready; low confidence about all possible BRENTOIL strategies because the prospective sample is one short.

hypothesis_decision.decision_reason: Development stress remains negative, source parity remains unresolved, and the first technically resolved prospective short stopped out under both nominal and stress friction.
hypothesis_decision.reopen_condition: A preregistered independent window resolves source and mark paths and remains positive after realistic costs and largest-winner removal, or a materially different mechanism is specified before results.

next_investigation.minimum_evidence_to_update_diagnosis: At least one attributable eligible signal and one fully resolved lifecycle for each configured direction.

claim_falsifiers: The immutable lifecycle snapshot does not reproduce the stated identity, side, stop exit, modeled nominal and stress losses, or resolved technical path.
Funding reconstruction reverses the loss and the remaining preregistered evidence becomes positive after costs and largest-winner removal.
Exact source parity or complete mark-path reconstruction materially changes the prospective lifecycle result.
A materially different mechanism specified before its outcomes produces independent both-side positive stress evidence.
